# `json_object_keys`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
json_object_keys(json_object)
```

Returns all the keys of the outermost JSON object as an array.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `json_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- json_object_keys, example 1
> SELECT json_object_keys('{}');
[]
```

```sql
-- json_object_keys, example 2
> SELECT json_object_keys('{"key": "value"}');
["key"]
```

```sql
-- json_object_keys, example 3
> SELECT json_object_keys('{"f1":"abc","f2":{"f3":"a", "f4":"b"}}');
["f1","f2"]
```
